finding: A supplemental two-panel geometric braid diagram is well motivated by the explicit relation and construction. The source and captures have no existing TikZ art; this is an opportunity, not a rendering defect.
crossing_convention: For sigma_k, the label k strand is m_k+rho and the label k+1 strand is m_k-rho. At the midpoint rho=(0,-h), so in the (horizontal position, transverse displacement, height) model the k strand passes on the negative-transverse side and the k+1 strand on the positive-transverse side. Label this convention or show the transverse viewing direction; do not silently substitute the opposite generator convention.
stacking_order: The source defines (gamma star beta) with beta in the lower half of the height interval and gamma in the upper half. Thus read the displayed words from bottom to top as rightmost factor first. Left panel bottom-to-top: sigma_i, sigma_{i+1}, sigma_i. Right panel bottom-to-top: sigma_{i+1}, sigma_i, sigma_{i+1}.
endpoint_check: Each generator transposes adjacent labels. Under pi(gamma star beta)=pi(gamma) composed with pi(beta), each three-factor word sends i to i+2, fixes i+1, sends i+2 to i, and fixes all other labels. Both panels therefore have identical labelled bottom and top endpoints. The top endpoint set is Q, but the two outer labels exchange; do not draw each strand as pointwise fixed at the top.
isotopy_check: The source supplies the common intermediate rotation rot through angle pi*u about q_{i+1}, with endpoint permutation (i i+2); the reflection and outer-label swap carry one bracketing to the other. An illustration may show the two words and the common half-turn braid, but it should not be presented as a proof of the collision-free interpolation.
capture_observation: All four local captures were opened at original pixel resolution. They show the statement and explicit proof without a braid diagram. No diagram-rendering failure was observed in these captures.
